# AppSync GraphQL

Run GraphQL APIs with local resolvers and WebSocket subscriptions.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `appsync` |
| Signing name | `appsync` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2017-07-25` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 36 of 74 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#appsync-graphql) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- JavaScript utilities and VTL form a local subset of AppSync runtimes.
- Subscriptions live in memory and close on shutdown.
- AppSync Events is a separate unimplemented surface.
- Production scaling, caching and every upstream resolver/data-source option are not reproduced.
- Reset keeps real-time WebSocket connections and their subscriptions.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
